protocol.input: RGB; Pillow bilinear resize 352x352; float32 /255; ImageNet normalization
protocol.probability_storage: compressed NPZ, key probability, float32, original HxW, no per-image minmax
protocol.metrics: per-image binary Dice and IoU, arithmetic mean within each group
protocol.empty_masks: GT and prediction both empty => Dice=IoU=1; exactly one empty => 0
protocol.overall: image-weighted mean across all samples, NOT equal-weight mean of dataset means
protocol.legacy: per-image minmax eps=1e-8, round to uint8, /255, threshold 0.5; both empty => 0 (old script convention)

timing: forward only, batch=1, synchronization before/after; excludes preprocess, resize/sigmoid, metrics and files
analysis_loop_timing: all selected images: decode, preprocess, transfer, inference, metrics and result writing; excludes audit, model loading and warmup
